stories.title: Mick Foley compares AEW and WWE storytelling
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley recently discussed his return to following professional wrestling during an appearance on The Mick and Kenny Show alongside Kofi Kingston. Foley explained that AEW currently speaks to him more than WWE because of how it handles its roster depth. He specifically praised AEW for making the middle of the card and the tag team division feel meaningful and important compared to other promotions.

stories.title: Samoa Joe praises Tony Khan's response to AEW tragedies
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion Samoa Joe has commended company president Tony Khan for his sensitive and admirable response to a difficult period marked by recent tragedies and the loss of several wrestling figures. Over the past month, AEW has held multiple tribute episodes following the passing of individuals including Rebel, Butcher, and PAC. Joe noted that while there is no official protocol for grief, the locker room has banded together with a sense of gratitude and a renewed appreciation for life.

stories.title: Kevin Knight discusses Steven Borden's injury at AEW All Out
stories.tldr: Wrestler Kevin Knight recently opened up about the frightening injury suffered by Steven Borden during a tag team match at AEW All Out 2026. After a rehearsed springboard clothesline went wrong and caused Borden to strike the back of his head on the mat, officials stopped the match. Knight accompanied Borden to the hospital and stayed with him overnight, noting that despite the scary bump, Borden was ultimately okay and they used the time to discuss growth and recovery.

stories.title: AEW talent booked in CMLL tag match with Tessa Blanchard
stories.tldr: Following recent teases, Dr. Britt Baker's official CMLL debut match has been set for this Friday at Arena Mexico. She will team with Persephone to take on Thunder Rosa and Tessa Blanchard in a marquee tag team match. The bout highlights a special all-female Viernes Espectacular card featuring various international talents and a major championship final.

stories.title: AEW stars react to WWE Men's Money in the Bank match
stories.tldr: Despite competing for rival promotions, several AEW stars publicly reacted to standout moments from the WWE Men's Money in the Bank ladder match. Je'Von Evans caught the attention of AEW's Ricochet after taking a massive, viral bump through an ambulance roof. Meanwhile, current AEW champion Andrade El Idolo took to social media to celebrate his former colleague Penta for winning the prestigious contract. These reactions highlight how professional fellowship often transcends company boundaries in the professional wrestling industry.

stories.title: Anthony Bowens provides knee injury and future update
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Tag Team Champion Anthony Bowens recently revealed in an interview that he is currently dealing with a slightly torn meniscus in his right knee, adding to a long list of injuries throughout his career including previous knee surgeries and concussions. Bowens also addressed his current free agency status following the expiration of his AEW contract, noting that he is taking things one day at a time. While he remained tight-lipped on his exact next steps to avoid widespread speculation, he admitted that he knows deep down what he wants to do next.

stories.title: AEW's Anna Jay to undergo surgery
stories.tldr: AEW star Anna Jay is set to undergo shoulder surgery to fix recurring dislocations that have kept her off television since June. She revealed on a Twitch stream that she sought multiple medical opinions before deciding on the procedure to ensure it was the right choice for her long-term health. This marks her second shoulder surgery in the company, following a previous operation in March 2021. Meanwhile, her future with the promotion is secured after Tony Khan confirmed she recently signed a contract extension.

stories.title: Jim Ross back in hospital due to low oxygen
stories.tldr: Legendary wrestling commentator Jim Ross has been hospitalized again due to low oxygen levels following a recent brain procedure for a shunt issue. The 74-year-old broadcaster shared the news on social media, noting his current weight of 198 pounds and expressing that he desperately needs a break from his ongoing health struggles. Ross has been away from the AEW commentary desk since May 2026, when he called the Continental Championship match at Double or Nothing.

stories.title: Skye Blue confirmed for MyAEW PPV in the UK
stories.tldr: AEW star Skye Blue is heading to the United Kingdom to challenge for the Spirit of EVE Championship against reigning titleholder Lucy Deathmatch at the upcoming Pro Wrestling EVE MyAEW PPV event. The high-stakes showdown takes place on Sunday, November 8, at The Hanger in Wolverhampton, England, and stems from a previous encounter during All In weekend. Several other prominent AEW and international names are also slated for the card, including Kris Statlander and Marina Shafir.

stories.title: Can’t Knock The Hustle: An Ode To Tag Team Wrestling
stories.tldr: This article is an affectionate tribute to tag team wrestling, penned in response to a reader request jokingly attributed to Ric Flair. The author highlights their personal favorite duos and matches rather than trying to define the absolute best of all time. The piece examines legendary tandems and unforgettable bouts, adhering strictly to traditional two-on-two tag rules. Featured subjects include the intense Steiner Brothers, the emotional farewell match of Sting and Darby Allin against The Young Bucks, the telepathic chemistry of The Usos, and a surprise classic between The Rockers and The Orient Express.

stories.title: PAC's wife Natalie shares tribute to late husband
stories.tldr: Natalie Satterley has shared a heartbreaking public tribute to her late husband, Benjamin Satterley, known to wrestling fans as PAC. Marking over two weeks since his sudden passing, she reflected on their 21 years together and the retirement plans they will no longer get to fulfill. Peers throughout the industry have continued to express their condolences and support for his grieving family.

stories.title: Matt Hardy praises AEW tribute to PAC
stories.tldr: Following the recent passing of PAC, AEW held an emotional tribute episode of Dynamite featuring special matches and video packages. TNA star Matt Hardy recently shared his thoughts on the broadcast during his podcast. Hardy praised the company for putting together a classy and well-done tribute that helped everyone grieve. He also reflected on an eerie Jon Moxley promo from All Out that featured PAC in hindsight.

stories.title: Max Caster seems to have picked the wrong target for an ‘edgy’ bar in his TNA debut
stories.tldr: Following his recent departure from AEW, Max Caster made a controversial TNA debut at Bound for Glory by dropping an unapproved freestyle rap. The lyrics referencing a glory hole and Riyadh drew immediate backstage heat and caused TNA to scrub the footage from their channels. Reports conflict on whether he has already been released or faces an uncertain future, but the incident has severely jeopardized his new run and complicated partner relations.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa and Charles Mason Kiss at Indie Show
stories.tldr: AEW star Tommaso Ciampa made a rare independent wrestling appearance at the House of Glory Salvation event on October 9, facing Charles Mason in the main event. During the match, the two sadistic competitors shocked fans by sharing a kiss as a psychological power play before trading blows. Ciampa ultimately won the match, marking his first indie victory in approximately a decade outside of major promotions like WWE and AEW.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Discusses Feud With Hangman Page
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland and Hangman Adam Page have shared one of the most intensely violent and hateful rivalries in All Elite Wrestling history, featuring shocking moments like Page burning down Strickland's childhood home and Strickland breaking into Page's residence. Despite the hostility now reaching the trios division, Strickland revealed in a recent interview that he hopes the program will ultimately be remembered as one of the greatest feuds in professional wrestling history. He attributes the captivating nature of their rivalry to a shared personal vulnerability and an ability to exploit each other's emotions in front of an eagerly anticipating audience.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream 2026 Match Card and Title Changes
stories.tldr: Following recent events at Grand Slam France, several new matches and title bouts have been added to the AEW WrestleDream 2026 card, including Andrade defending the National Championship against Tommaso Ciampa and Mercedes Mone defending the Women's World Title against Thekla. Additionally, Wrathlander earned a tag team title shot, and the United Empire faction officially expanded with new members. The upcoming three-hour go-home show will also feature multiple high-profile tag team and preview matches.

stories.title: AEW's Dr. Britt Baker teased for CMLL appearance at Arena Mexico
stories.tldr: CMLL Women's World Champion Persephone has heavily teased that AEW star Dr. Britt Baker, D.M.D. will make a surprise appearance at Arena Mexico on Friday, October 16. Following a tag team loss at Viernes Espectacular, Persephone addressed her critics in a backstage promo by using the signature DMD hand signal and winking at the camera. The two wrestlers recently shared an AEW ring on the September 30 episode of Dynamite, cementing their working relationship.

stories.title: Brian Cage details working with Steven Spielberg on Disclosure Day
stories.tldr: AEW star Brian Cage recently discussed his surprising appearance in Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day alongside fellow wrestlers Lance Archer and Chavo Guerrero. During a recent podcast appearance, Cage explained that Guerrero helped him land the audition, after which Spielberg personally selected him based on his look and charisma. Cage also revealed that Spielberg is a wrestling fan and even let him choose Archer as his on-screen opponent for the film's opening sequence.

stories.title: Steph De Lander reflects on leaving TNA for Ring of Honor
stories.tldr: Steph De Lander recently opened up about requesting her release from TNA earlier this year and seamlessly transitioning to Ring of Honor, where she is enjoying creative freedom and an active wrestling schedule after recovering from a severe neck injury. Despite leaving TNA on bad terms with zero ongoing communication with management, she is not entirely ruling out a potential return far down the line. Currently, De Lander is working on a pay-per-appearance basis for Ring of Honor and is not yet officially under a long-term contract with ROH or AEW.

stories.title: AEW TNT Champion Darby Allin climbs Mont Blanc
stories.tldr: AEW TNT Champion Darby Allin has continued his extreme mountaineering exploits by successfully climbing Mont Blanc in the Alps following a successful title defense in France. The achievement comes on the heels of Allin's historic climb up Mount Everest earlier in the year, where he became the first professional wrestler to reach the summit. Allin documented his latest ascent on social media, expressing his joy at returning to high-altitude climbing.

stories.title: Clockwork Carnage qualifier matches set for 3-hour AEW Dynamite special
stories.tldr: AEW has announced five high-stakes qualifying matches for the upcoming Clockwork Carnage match at WrestleDream 2026, which will take place on a special three-hour episode of Dynamite and Collision. The newly revealed bouts feature several championship stakes, including Darby Allin defending his TNT Title against Hechicero and Kazuchika Okada putting his International Title on the line against Myron Reed. Additional qualifiers will see Ricochet face Ace Austin, Konosuke Takeshita battle Brian Cage, and Adam Copeland square off against Josh Alexander. Furthermore, the massive three-hour card will feature high-profile trios action with Mercedes Mone teaming up with Divine Dominion against the Triangle of Madness, alongside a clash between the Death Riders and the Don Callis Family.

stories.title: Kris Statlander & Harley Cameron become #1 contenders for AEW Women's World Tag Titles
stories.tldr: Kris Statlander and Harley Cameron officially secured their spot as the number one contenders for the AEW Women’s World Tag Team titles. At Collision Grand Slam France, the duo defeated the Sisters of Sin and Divine Dominion in a chaotic three-way match. Statlander pinned Julia Hart after Cameron eliminated outside interference, setting up their championship match at WrestleDream.

stories.title: AEW announces 3-hour Dynamite and Winter Is Coming special in Mexico
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has announced major plans for December 2026, featuring a special three-hour live episode of Dynamite in Laredo, Texas, followed by an international trip to Monterrey, Mexico. The annual Winter Is Coming event will take place on December 9 at Arena Monterrey, marking the promotion's first show outside of Mexico City. Both a live Dynamite and a taped Collision will emanate from the venue, incorporating matches from the Continental Classic tournament on the road to the Worlds End pay-per-view.

stories.title: Max Caster removed from AEW roster page following exit
stories.tldr: Max Caster has been removed from the official AEW roster page following the expiration of his contract in early October. Meanwhile, his former tag team partner Anthony Bowens remains listed on the AEW website despite his contract also expiring at the same time. Caster is already moving on to his next chapter and is scheduled to make his TNA Wrestling debut at Bound for Glory 2026 against Moose. Bowens' future with AEW remains uncertain as he has not yet confirmed a new deal or a departure.

stories.title: Juice Robinson reflects on leaving WWE developmental system in 2014
stories.tldr: AEW star Juice Robinson recently reflected on his decision to leave WWE developmental in 2014, where he previously wrestled as CJ Parker in early NXT. Motivated by peers who succeeded outside of WWE and a desire to truly learn how to wrestle, Robinson grew tired of the strict system and wanted international experience. With the help of WWE Performance Center trainer Matt Bloom, who had connections to New Japan Pro-Wrestling, Robinson successfully transitioned to the independent scene and NJPW.

stories.title: Will Ospreay discusses using PAC tribute move on Dynamite
stories.tldr: AEW World Champion Will Ospreay recently reflected on his emotional match against Ricochet on AEW Dynamite, which served as a heartfelt tribute to their late friend Pac. During the bout, Ospreay successfully executed Pac's iconic Black Arrow finishing move for the first time in nearly a decade. Ospreay admitted that hitting the notoriously difficult maneuver after years of not performing it was one of the toughest challenges of his career. Despite their usual competitive egos and desire for the championship, both men managed to put their differences aside to properly honor their influential friend.

stories.title: Dutch Mantell gives thoughts on Sting's son Steven Borden in AEW
stories.tldr: Following the recent injury discussion surrounding Steven Borden, veteran wrestling figure Dutch Mantell has shared his perspective on the younger Borden's mindset in AEW. Mantell believes that as the son of Sting, Borden feels immense pressure to prove he is not having opportunities handed to him. While Mantell respects this strong work ethic and desire to earn his own way, he cautions that second-generation wrestlers need experienced guidance to avoid taking excessive risks in the ring.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer assesses potential entrants for AEW WrestleDream Clockwork Carnage match
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer has speculated on the potential remaining participants for the upcoming Clockwork Carnage match at AEW WrestleDream 2026. Will Ospreay and Samoa Joe have already secured their spots in the eight-person bout, with another qualifier pending between Speedball Mike Bailey and Lee Moriarty. Meltzer's list of logical contenders includes top stars like Adam Copeland, Darby Allin, and Ricochet, though the exact field is still taking shape ahead of the October event.

stories.title: Update regarding cause of death for PAC / Neville
stories.tldr: The official cause of death for Benjamin Satterley, widely known as PAC and Neville, remains undetermined while authorities await further medical testing. Toxicology results and final findings from the Cook County Medical Examiner could take several weeks or months to process. Investigators have not yet released a confirmed explanation for the tragic incident that occurred in Chicago on September 27.
